Generic header with an optional centred service title

Source: R/header.R
header.Rd

A page-level header based on GOV.UK Frontend's Generic header. The linked organisation identity uses the upstream structure. The separate service title is a shinyGovstyle extension: centred on wide screens and stacked below the organisation on smaller screens. Use one header per page.

Usage

header(
  org_name = "Shiny example app",
  service_name = NULL,
  logo = NULL,
  main_text = lifecycle::deprecated(),
  secondary_text = lifecycle::deprecated(),
  main_link = lifecycle::deprecated(),
  secondary_link = lifecycle::deprecated(),
  logo_alt_text = "Departmental logo",
  main_alt_text = lifecycle::deprecated(),
  secondary_alt_text = lifecycle::deprecated(),
  logo_width = 66,
  logo_height = 34,
  width = "standard",
  homepage_url = "/",
  classes = NULL,
  attributes = list()
)

Arguments

org_name

Organisation name. Use NULL for an image-only identity, with meaningful logo_alt_text.

service_name

Optional service title, outside the homepage link.

logo

URL or app-relative path to your own logo. Defaults to NULL (text only). The "crown" shortcut is no longer supported; use your own logo or NULL instead.

main_text

Use org_name instead. Will be removed in shinyGovstyle 1.0.0.

secondary_text

Use service_name instead. Will be removed in shinyGovstyle 1.0.0.

main_link, secondary_link, main_alt_text, secondary_alt_text

Have no effect and will be removed in shinyGovstyle 1.0.0. Use homepage_url for the organisation link.

logo_alt_text

Alternative text for a custom logo. Use "" when the adjacent organisation name already identifies it. An image-only identity requires meaningful alternative text to name the homepage link.

logo_width, logo_height

Image dimensions, in pixels for numeric values or as CSS lengths. Applied to each image independently.

width

Width of the component. One of "standard" (the default, GOV.UK's usual 960px content width), "three-quarters" (three-quarters of the viewport, never narrower than standard), "full" (no max-width, so the container fills the viewport, with grid gutters also removed), or a CSS length (e.g. "1400px", "90vw") for a custom max-width.

homepage_url

Organisation homepage URL. Defaults to / (the domain root). For an app hosted at https://example.org/my-app/, use homepage_url = "/my-app/" to return to that app instead.

classes

Additional CSS classes for the outer header.

attributes

Named list of HTML attributes for the outer header, such as list(id = "site-header") or a named data-brand attribute. Use classes for CSS classes; the banner role cannot be overridden.

Value

A header HTML Shiny tag object.

Details

This replaces the previous branded-header markup for v1.0.0. Update CSS selectors from govuk-header* to the Generic header classes or the package-owned shinygovstyle-header* classes. The organisation now links to homepage_url; service_name remains supported and is not a link.

Generic header does not remove branding elsewhere in your app. Review fonts, colours, favicons and footer imagery separately against the guidance on using Frontend without GOV.UK branding. The header uses a system sans-serif font rather than GDS Transport.

See also

Other Govstyle page structure: cookieBanner(), footer(), gov_page(), layouts, phase_banner(), skip_to_main()

Examples

header("Example organisation")
#> <header class="govuk-generic-header shinygovstyle-header " role="banner">
#>   <div class="govuk-generic-header__container shinygovstyle-header__container  govuk-width-container">
#>     <div class="govuk-generic-header__logo">
#>       <a href="/" class="govuk-generic-header__homepage-link shinygovstyle-header__link">
#>         <span class="shinygovstyle-header__organisation">Example organisation</span>
#>       </a>
#>     </div>
#>   </div>
#> </header>
header("Example organisation", "My service", homepage_url = "/my-app/")
#> <header class="govuk-generic-header shinygovstyle-header " role="banner">
#>   <div class="govuk-generic-header__container shinygovstyle-header__container shinygovstyle-header__container--with-service govuk-width-container">
#>     <div class="govuk-generic-header__logo">
#>       <a href="/my-app/" class="govuk-generic-header__homepage-link shinygovstyle-header__link">
#>         <span class="shinygovstyle-header__organisation">Example organisation</span>
#>       </a>
#>     </div>
#>     <div class="shinygovstyle-header__service-name">My service</div>
#>   </div>
#> </header>
header(
  "Ministry of Justice", "My service",
  logo = "shinyGovstyle/images/moj_logo.png",
  logo_alt_text = "", homepage_url = "/my-app/"
)
#> <header class="govuk-generic-header shinygovstyle-header " role="banner">
#>   <div class="govuk-generic-header__container shinygovstyle-header__container shinygovstyle-header__container--with-service govuk-width-container">
#>     <div class="govuk-generic-header__logo">
#>       <a href="/my-app/" class="govuk-generic-header__homepage-link shinygovstyle-header__link">
#>         <img src="shinyGovstyle/images/moj_logo.png" class="shinygovstyle-header__image" alt="" style="width:66px;height:34px;"/>
#>          
#>         <span class="shinygovstyle-header__organisation">Ministry of Justice</span>
#>       </a>
#>     </div>
#>     <div class="shinygovstyle-header__service-name">My service</div>
#>   </div>
#> </header>
